Since ranking instability is high, I will test if expanding the pool to include the next best models (pool7, created in the last step) allows for a more robust combination, specifically testing the DBA algorithm which adapts weights based on forecast similarity/variance rather than just static error metrics.

decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.994. Series context: trend strength 0.8651 and seasonal strength 0.1038; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.041); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.504.
